details: Federal Reserve Vice Chair Philip Jefferson indicated that policymakers might need more time before another interest rate hike, lowering expectations for an October increase. This sentiment was reinforced by a softer-than-expected US non-farm payrolls report for September, which saw the economy add only 29,000 jobs, compared to an expected 90,000, and the unemployment rate holding at 4.2%. Lower rate hike expectations could reduce pressure on risk assets like cryptocurrencies.
title: Fed Signals Potential Pause on Rate Hikes Following Soft Jobs Data

details: Citigroup has increased its 12-month forecasts for Bitcoin and Ethereum, citing robust crypto activity, a supportive macroeconomic environment, and a resumption of ETF inflows. The brokerage raised its Bitcoin target to $113,000 from $82,000 and Ethereum to $3,028 from $2,240, also projecting $5 billion in ETF inflows over the next year.
title: Citi Raises Bitcoin and Ethereum Price Targets Amid Strong Crypto Activity

details: European Union officials are reportedly questioning cryptocurrency exchange Binance regarding its continued operations in the region. This comes despite an earlier order for Binance to wind down its business in the bloc after it failed to obtain a license under new EU crypto regulations (MiCA). Regulators are examining Binance's use of "reverse solicitation" as an exemption.
title: EU Questions Binance Over Continued Operations Despite Wind-Down Order

details: A recent Reuters poll of FX strategists indicates that the U.S. dollar is expected to give up most of its recent gains over the next year, despite a rally of over 3% since early September driven by a hawkish Federal Reserve. While near-term strength is anticipated, the consensus view remains for eventual dollar weakness.
title: US Dollar Strength Expected to Fizzle, FX Forecasters Suggest

details: The U.S. economy's Gross Domestic Product (GDP) for the second quarter was revised upwards to an annualized rate of 2.2% from an initial 1.5%. Concurrently, the Federal Reserve's preferred inflation gauge, the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index, rose by 3.4% year-on-year in August, lower than the expected 3.7%. Core PCE, excluding food and energy, also came in below expectations at 3.0%.
title: US Q2 GDP Revised Up, August PCE Inflation Below Forecast

details: Bloomberg has integrated a stablecoin analytics dashboard into its Terminal platform, powered by blockchain data provider Allium. This new feature offers institutional subscribers comprehensive data on stablecoins, including supply, minting, burning, transfer volume, and velocity metrics across various networks, with hourly updates.
title: Bloomberg Terminal Integrates Stablecoin Analytics Dashboard
